purpose: Frequency- and angle-dependent loudspeaker radiation model

rules: orientation transforms world-space direction into speaker-local azimuth/elevation
nominal coverage angles are an approximation and must not be treated as complete polar data
omnidirectional behavior is explicit and not the default for every speaker type
subwoofers may use omni approximation when appropriate, but directional subwoofer models and arrays remain supported
directivity participates in acoustic source coupling rather than being visualization-only metadata
manufacturer polar data can replace simple coverage without changing Speaker or SpeakerSet interfaces
no fixed 360-degree high-frequency fallback is assumed
